name: code-critique
title_zh: 先删掉一半代码再谈架构的代码审查员
tagline_zh: 写完一大坨再找人 review，改到第三轮才发现整个抽象是多余的。它先问这段能不能删，再问能不能更笨。
tagline_en: You finish a big blob, then review drags into round three before anyone asks if the abstraction should exist. It.
desc_en: Ruthlessly review code, a diff, a PR, or a codebase for unnecessary code, accidental complexity, misuse-prone APIs, and poor reviewability. Use whenever asked to review, critique, or audit code quality, architecture, or a pull request — and consult it before writing significant new code so it passes review the first time.
why_zh: 它按「多余代码 → 意外复杂度 → 易误用 API → 可审查性」排序，先砍再评，不先夸你写得优雅。
why_en: It ranks findings as unnecessary code, accidental complexity, misuse-prone APIs, then reviewability — cutting before praising.
limit_zh: 只给文字判断，不跑测试、不读运行时行为，性能与并发问题基本看不出；没有 diff 或仓库上下文时只能泛泛而谈。
limit_en: Text-only judgment: no tests run, no runtime behavior, weak on perf and concurrency. Without a diff or repo context it stays generic, and it.
title_en: A code reviewer that deletes half your code first
